message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t give you an up‑to‑date forecast for San Francisco. However, here’s what you typically expect:

| Season | Typical Temperature Range | Common Weather Patterns |
|--------|---------------------------|-------------------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48°F – 58°F (9°C – 14°C) | Mostly cloudy; occasional fog near the coast; light rain on rare days. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55°F – 68°F (13°C – 20°C) | Gradually warming; still some coastal fog early in spring; sunny afternoons become more common toward May. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57°F – 75°F (14°C – 24°C) | Cool evenings due to marine layer; daytime highs rarely exceed 80°F (27°C). Fog rolls inland from the ocean at times. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 56°F – 70°F (13°C – 21°C) | Warmest part of the year; decreasing cloud cover; mild nights. |

If you need a precise, real‑time update, check your favorite weather app or website—like NOAA, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service—for the latest conditions.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
